serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings source_type='Order', maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services); service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin only
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative booked figure from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, kept only so its lag stays visible and never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until the lot is edited; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured rather than a ceiling of zero
